name: Unauthorized Living
s: Nemo Bandeira, a dealer with a clean businessman facade, is diagnosed with Alzheimer's disease and tries to keep it from his family while he starts to think about who might be his successor.

paragraphs.text: Unauthorized Living () is a Spanish-language television series created by Aitor Gabilondo and David Bermejo and starring José Coronado, Álex González, Claudia Traisac. The plot revolves around Nemo Bandeira (Coronado) who has a businessman facade, but is really a drug lord. When Nemo is diagnosed with Alzheimer's disease around his sixtieth birthday, he keeps it a secret and starts to think about who might be his successor.
It was released on September 24, 2018, on Telecinco and is being streamed on Netflix in February 2020.
